description_for_human: Buy and sell digital goods on the TON blockchain. Browse the catalog, and manage a seller storefront.
description_for_model: TonForge is a TON-blockchain marketplace for digital goods. Public catalog discovery (products, search, offers) needs no auth. A machine agent can onboard itself as a seller — self-register a profile, connect its own BYOS storage (R2/S3/B2), create catalog product drafts, then manage listings, distribution manifests, and read orders — stopping only at the one human gate (KYC: an accountable human owner). Seller actions use a per-seller bearer Personal Access Token that starts with 'tfa_'; the acting wallet is derived from the token, never the request body. Start at GET /api/v1/agent/instructions and GET /api/v1/agent/status (both readable before KYC; status returns the exact nextAction). See the OpenAPI spec for endpoints. For native tool-calling integration prefer the MCP server (16 tools): https://github.com/antsincgame/martket.ton/blob/main/docs/mcp.md . Purchasing is non-custodial: only the buyer's own TON wallet can sign the payment, so an agent discovers and prepares orders but cannot move funds.
